summary: Mercedes-Benz card had almost all generation years null. Filled production years and status for about 120 generations from fixed-revision en.wikipedia infoboxes, corrected W204 start (2006→2007) and W205 end (2021→2023), added facelifts for 13 generations, added the new 2026 GLA and GLB generations, set B-Class W247/EQA/EQB as ended in 2026. Proposed removal of 26 non-car or foreign-make entries from models-auto (race and record cars, concepts, trucks, Lotec/Carlsson).
